build_mlplayer: build an MLPLayer with configurable input_dim, hidden_size, layer_N, orthogonal init, and ReLU activation
build_mlpbase: build an MLPBase network from args and obs_shape with optional feature normalization
test_mlplayer_forward: test the MLPLayer forward pass by passing input tensor through fc1 and fc2 layers
test_mlpbase_forward: test the MLPBase forward pass with optional feature normalization before the MLP layer
review_mlplayer_init: review the MLPLayer init to understand orthogonal vs xavier initialization and activation function selection
